name: Button
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Button. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Label
settings.how: Enter the label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: URL
settings.info: The link appears on the storefront after a label and destination are set.
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.
